versions.content: If MirrorStatusCanId is configured and when one or more source bus states have changed, the Bus Mirroring module shall allocate a new status frame buffer and write the header in the layout defined by [SWS_Mirror_00127]. The SHProtocolVersion field shall be set to 1 .
